event: Iran asserts control over and restricts commercial passage through the Strait of Hormuz.
A two-week ceasefire agreement is reached.
The United States begins a naval blockade of Iranian ports.
source_note: CENTCOM confirms initial implementation date in July resumption notice

event: The United States and Iran reach an initial agreement to open the Strait and extend the ceasefire.
source_note: Associated Press nuclear-program and conflict chronology

event: Iran strikes three commercial vessels that had bypassed its Iran-approved transit route through the Strait, breaking down the June memorandum of understanding.

event: The June US-Iran memorandum of understanding collapses after the renewed attacks.
